purpose: Gate terminal recovery candidates on the same source-backed readiness predicate used by execution.

rules.current_readiness_only: A terminal action is executable only when current adapter admission and current Embodiment preflight both establish the terminal predicate.
rules.remembered_or_stale_evidence: Remembered, stale, or merely learned opportunity evidence cannot establish current terminal executability; the current execution preflight is authoritative.
rules.unknown: Missing adapter or embodiment preflight support returns UNKNOWN and fails closed for terminal selection.
rules.motion: APPROACH, MOVE, ORIENT, RETREAT, and IDLE are not terminal-preflight gated; their outcomes remain execution-verified.
rules.critical_recovery: Initial critical recovery and subsequent recovery alternatives use the same terminal readiness gate before selection.
rules.ordinary_selection: Ordinary terminal candidates are removed from the admissible pool unless the categorical result is EXECUTABLE.
rules.execution_identity: No readiness status is persisted as an experience unless an executed action produces a VerifiedOutcome.
rules.source_of_truth: Terminal preflight is recomputed from current owner state at the decision tick; no cached readiness authority is used.

protected_boundaries.policy_exposure: Categorical status only; no Habitat coordinates, feature values, IDs, scores, or hidden world truth cross into arbitration.
